{{Quote|Call me Bernie. You wouldn't happen t'have a cigar on you?|Bernie to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="oseon" />}}
'''Bernie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dilonexican]] customs agent on [[Dilonexa XXIII]]. He was a small man with wiry [[Limb/Legends|arms and legs]], knobby knuckles, a shiny pink scalp, and gray [[Hair/Legends|stubble]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he received a message from [[Administrator Senior]] [[Lob Doluff]] of the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] for one [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who arrived on the planet soon afterward. Unfortunately for Calrissian, he was informed by Bernie that his cargo of fishing poles, [[wintenberry jelly]], and hides would be useless to the native [[Dilonexican]]s. The agent then delivered the message to Calrissian at a price of 1,350 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], threatening a 2,000-credit penalty when the gambler first refused the price.<ref name="oseon" />
